standard.summary: 当前 loss 超过滑动窗口均值多少倍时判定为 spike（异常跳升）。默认 5.0。
standard.effect: 阈值越小越敏感，越容易误触发；越大则容忍更大的 loss 波动。触发后执行自动降 LR 或计入统计。
standard.whenToUse: 初训新素材时 loss 变化较大，建议调高到 8~10。稳定收敛阶段可降至 3~5 以更敏锐捕捉异常。
standard.avoidWhen: 不建议设为 1~2（对正常 loss 波动过于敏感，会频繁触发降 LR 影响收敛）。

standard_en.summary: How many times the sliding-window mean the current loss has to exceed to count as a spike (an abnormal jump). Default 5.0.
standard_en.effect: A smaller threshold is more sensitive and misfires more easily; a larger one tolerates more loss fluctuation. Once triggered it lowers the LR automatically or is counted in the statistics.
standard_en.whenToUse: The loss moves around a lot when you first train on new material, so 8~10 is advisable then. In a steady convergence phase you can drop to 3~5 to catch anomalies more keenly.
standard_en.avoidWhen: 1~2 is not advisable (too sensitive to normal loss fluctuation, it keeps lowering the LR and hurts convergence).

advanced.principle: spike_score = current_loss / (window_mean + 1e-8)，超过阈值触发。配合 loss_window_size 控制均值基准稳定性。
advanced.tradeoffs: 训练早期 loss 尚未稳定时窗口均值本身波动大，阈值设低容易误触发。

advanced_en.principle: spike_score = current_loss / (window_mean + 1e-8); exceeding the threshold triggers. Pair with loss_window_size to control the stability of the mean baseline.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Early in training the loss is not yet stable, so the window mean itself fluctuates a lot and a low threshold easily misfires.
